name: hotportion-mobile
description: Hot Portion Grill - Mobile Capacitor Build

scripts.ios:build: npx cap copy ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:build-release: npx cap copy ios && npx cap open ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath App.xcarchive archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath App.xcarchive -exportPath ../ -exportOptionsPlist exportOptions.plist
scripts.android:build: npx cap copy android && npx cap open android
